exercises.title: Variables: Basic Assignment
exercises.description: Assign values to variables of different types.
exercises.context: Python uses dynamic typing and no keywords like var or let.
exercises.codeSnippet:
user_id = 101
user_name = 'Ignacio'
is_active = True

exercises.title: Lists: Appending and Access
exercises.description: Create a list and add an element.
exercises.context: Lists are the most versatile collection type in Python.
exercises.codeSnippet:
fruits = ['apple', 'banana']
fruits.append('orange')
first_fruit = fruits[0]

exercises.title: Strings: F-Strings
exercises.context: Modern and readable way to include variables in strings.
exercises.codeSnippet:
name = 'Nacho'
age = 25
msg = f'Hello, {name}. You are {age} years old.'

exercises.title: Functions: Basic Definition
exercises.description: Define a simple function with parameters.
exercises.context: Functions are defined with the def keyword and indentation.
exercises.codeSnippet:
def greet(name, greeting='Hello'):
    return f'{greeting}, {name}!'

exercises.title: Conditionals: If-Elif-Else
exercises.description: Standard control flow with multiple conditions.
exercises.context: Python uses elif instead of else if.
technicalNotes: Logical operators are keywords: and, or, not

exercises.title: Loops: For Over List
exercises.description: Iterate over elements in a list.
exercises.context: Python's for loop is an 'iterator' loop.
technicalNotes: No need for range() if only elements are needed

exercises.title: Dictionaries: Basic Usage
exercises.description: Create a dictionary and access a value.

exercises.title: List Comprehensions: Basic
exercises.description: Generate a list using compact syntax.
exercises.context: Pythonic way to transform or filter data.
exercises.codeSnippet:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
squares = [n**2 for n in numbers]

exercises.title: Error Handling: Try-Except
Classes: Simple Definition
exercises.description: Create a basic class with an __init__ method.
exercises.context: Foundation of Object Oriented Programming in Python.
technicalNotes: self refers to the current instance

exercises.title: Loops: While Loop
exercises.description: Basic while loop with a counter.
exercises.codeSnippet:
count = 0
while count < 5:
    print(count)
    count += 1

exercises.title: Tuples: Unpacking
exercises.codeSnippet:
point = (10, 20)
x, y = point
print(f'X: {x}, Y: {y}')

exercises.title: Sets: Uniqueness
exercises.description: Create a set to remove duplicates.
exercises.codeSnippet:
nums = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3]
unique_nums = set(nums)
unique_nums.add(4)

exercises.title: Strings: Joining Lists
exercises.description: Combine a list of strings into one string.
exercises.codeSnippet:
words = ['Python', 'is', 'great']
sentence = ' '.join(words)

exercises.title: Functions: Multiple Returns
exercises.description: Return more than one value from a function.

exercises.title: Lambdas: Anonymous Functions
exercises.codeSnippet:
double = lambda x: x * 2
result = double(10)

exercises.title: Itertools: Enumerate
exercises.description: Loop with both index and value.

exercises.title: Type Hinting: Basics
exercises.codeSnippet:
